name: Duplicate Competency Proficiency

add-rank.description: Each separately authorized duplicate proficiency beyond the first adds exactly one rank in that same Competency. Independently authored ranks are unaffected.

alternate-proficiency.description: Each separately authorized duplicate proficiency instead permits an explicitly chosen proficiency in a different native Competency that does not already receive proficiency. The choice must preserve the source occurrence, and explicit ranks remain on their original Competency.

description: A trusted ruleset or campaign setting selects exactly one duplicate-proficiency resolution. An occurrence of the same grant twice is invalid and is never a means of acquiring a benefit.
reviewNotes: The provisional default favors specialization; the alternate policy favors breadth. Their relative balance awaits playtest and broader rank progression review.
Both policies are supported now, but this is a ruleset-level switch rather than an exposed player-facing optional rule toggle. A later balance review may justify an explicit optional rule.

The Competency reducer validates catalog references, occurrence identity, replacement completeness and uniqueness. Source authorization and the permission to select the configured policy remain upstream.
Skill and tool duplicate proficiencies use separate same-kind replacements. Binary weapon qualifications, language knowledge, and Weapon Mastery are not Competency training.
